name_zh: 吉尔吉斯·玛纳斯史诗：口述英雄与统一
name_en: Kyrgyz Manas Epic: Oral Hero & Unification
description_zh: 《玛纳斯》史诗是吉尔吉斯民族宏大口述史诗，讲述英雄玛纳斯统一四十部落、抗击卡尔吕克外敌、建立吉尔吉斯汗国的传奇，通过玛纳斯奇(说唱艺人)代际口述传承，成为吉尔吉斯民族认同核心与文化基因。
description_en: Manas Epic is Kyrgyz grand oral epic, narrates hero Manas uniting forty tribes, resisting Karluk foreign enemies, establishing Kyrgyz Khanate legend, transmitted intergenerationally through Manaschi(reciters), becoming Kyrgyz national identity core and cultural gene.
reason_zh: 玛纳斯史诗代表游牧民族口述传统的巅峰，展示了没有文字记录的民族如何通过口述表演维持历史记忆、民族认同与文化连续性，是联合国非遗代表作。
reason_en: Manas Epic represents nomadic oral tradition peak, demonstrating how peoples without written records maintain historical memory, ethnic identity and cultural continuity through oral performance, a UNESCO Intangible Heritage masterpiece.
steps_zh: 研究玛纳斯史诗八万行规模与三部曲结构(玛纳斯、塞梅泰、塞耶特)
分析玛纳斯奇说唱艺人代际传承与即兴创作机制
探讨史诗中游牧法制、婚姻习俗、部落政治的完整呈现
评估苏联时期史诗民族主义化与独立后国家象征建构
总结玛纳斯史诗对吉尔吉斯语言标准化与民族认同的奠基作用
steps_en: Study Manas Epic 80000 lines scale and trilogy structure (Manas, Semetey, Seytek)
Analyze Manaschi reciter intergenerational transmission and improvisational creation mechanism
Explore epic presentation of nomadic law, marriage customs, tribal politics
Evaluate Soviet period epic nationalization and post-independence state symbol construction
Summarize Manas Epic foundational role in Kyrgyz language standardization and national identity
expected_zh: 理解口述传统如何承载民族历史记忆与政治智慧，掌握非物质文化遗产活态传承机制，评估玛纳斯史诗对中亚游牧文明现代性转型的文化支撑。
expected_en: Understand how oral tradition carries national historical memory and political wisdom, grasp living intangible heritage transmission mechanism, evaluate Manas Epic cultural support for Central Asian nomadic civilization modernity transition.
case_zh: 玛纳斯史诗八万行三部曲；玛纳斯奇代际口述传承；2009 列入联合国非遗；2017 吉尔吉斯斯坦建立玛纳斯研究院。口述英雄统一范式永存。
case_en: Manas Epic 80000 lines trilogy; Manaschi intergenerational oral transmission; 2009 UNESCO Intangible Heritage; 2017 Kyrgyzstan established Manas Institute. Oral hero unification paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Oral tradition peak; UNESCO heritage; nomadic law; national identity gene
artistic_legacy: 是: 口述史诗/说唱艺术
